scenario_or_breakage: An empty string is falsy, so normalized_outcome_values falls back to os.environ STALL_TRACKING. After Step 5 stall the orchestrator can still export STALL_TRACKING=true while ship-pr-state.sh and finalize-state.sh already show a recovered pr-created run. The helper then sees any_stall=true, outcome stays stalled, and IMPLEMENT_MERGE_DOWNGRADED never becomes true even though summary-final.md should report pr-created.
suggested_fix: Pass in_memory_stall_tracking="false" (or read durable layers only) when evaluating merge downgrade from ship-seed-input.env and execution-issues.md, matching the Step 18a.5 post-clear-stall contract.
